Description.Name: MF Laser A-Small T2
Description.Details:
Persistant heat per turn to target: -1.
Duration of extra heat: 5 turns.
Maximum cumulative effects on target: 3x.
Heat generated per turn: +1.
Damage taken from all sources: 101.5000%.

    Westonmach Multi-Frequency Battlemech lasers are super-intense laser weapons that shoot a laser beam containing multiple lasers of different frequencies at the same time, integrated into one beam of energy.  They do a serious amount of damage to their targets, and also heat up the target when they hit.  Like regular battlemech-mounted lasers, they enjoy an accuracy bonus, and don't require any ammunition.  The small versions are support weapons that fire during melee.

    Westonmach Multi-Frequency lasers will temporarily impair a target's ability to cool itself, overheating the target on a successful hit.  A target hit by one of these lasers will have a lower maximum heat threshold for a few turns, as well as a lower threshold for shutting down.  In addition, while a target that has been hit is cooling off, the damaged area is melting and hot, and for a short time won't protect the target as much from further damage, making other damage temporarily reduce armor and structure a little more than it normally would.

    These weapons come in different "type" levels (Type 1, Type 2, etc.).  Versions of weapons of a higher type have increased damage, range, and sometimes accuracy, but also weaken the structural integrity of a battlemech's armor as a trade-off.

Description.Name: INSTALLED EQUIPMENT HEAT GENERATED TRADEOFF

Description.Name: INSTALLED EQUIPMENT DAMAGE RESIST PENALTY
Description.Details: This battlemech takes [AMT] damage from all sources and types of attacks, as a trade-off for equipped weapons and other items.

Description.Name: HEAT FROM THERMAL DAMAGE
Description.Details: This battlemech has suffered damage that temporarily results in [AMT] additional heat per turn.
